module: "Dev Notes" section of the Mission Editor: edits mission.devNotes (free text, silent/info/warning/error mode, "Dev Mission" checkbox that hides the mission outside developer mode). The module returns a constructor. Each modification sets mission._dirty = true.
notes: In missionEditor.lua the line that creates this window is commented out: the module is currently not instantiated.
mission.devNotes must exist (setMission reads devNotes.text and devNotes.devMission without a test) otherwise error.
Modes: silent, info, warning, error (icons visibility_off, info, warning, error, declared but not displayed here).

init.desc: Constructor: remembers the reference to the missionEditor.

setMission.desc: Selects the mission: creates the text buffer (2048 characters) and the devMission checkbox from mission.devNotes.

draw.desc: Draws the multiline text, the mode selector and the "Dev Mission" checkbox (tooltip: the mission only appears if dev mode is enabled).
